dataset.deduplication: before splitting, exclude train content hashes occurring in official valid; then group by SHA-256 of int8 sign(X[:5000]) and retain minimum row index per group

training.selection: maximum source_validation macro_f1; earliest epoch on exact tie

evaluation.valid_positions: inclusive RF entirely inside nonzero finite input positions per sample; treat zero as unknown
evaluation.insufficient_positions: fewer than 4: D/E fallback to C; exclude ineligible references; if any class lacks eligible reference all D/E fallback to C
evaluation.same_layer_control_E: cosine 1-NN on normalized raw-position mean over exactly D-valid positions
